## The short version

- Three short lessons are taught once and linked wherever a course needs them.
- They cover how to read a CFR citation, how to sort a rule into regulation, guidance or AABB Standard, and the risk and controls vocabulary used everywhere later.
- Later courses assume you already have all three, so each one is taught once here and linked from there.
:::
